lane: Admin: Trò chuyện với tri thức, Lô 2 Admin page for persona model tiers (Hạng model người dẫn) plus the workflow-catalog text for persona chat and the stale persona count in the content-sync test
goal: The Owner can view the active persona model tier config, edit a draft (tiers: label, own models or the active route, primary and fallback model, reasoning, output ceiling, total wait, per-message budget, history, answer style; plus the wall clock setting), see client-side validation with the same rules as the SQL validator, see a diff against the active version, and publish with a 10-500 character note (Owner only). Each of the 19 personas from the Admin content seed is assigned to one tier. A missing migration shows a clear 'chưa áp migration' state.
successCriteria: AI Studio has a route #model-tiers (nav item 'Hạng model người dẫn' in the AI group) that calls get_ai_persona_model_tiers with ai.read and shows the active version or the code defaults.

The draft form covers every field the SQL validator accepts; the client validator returns the same error codes as nilaza_private.ai_persona_model_tiers_errors for the test fixtures, and Lưu nháp is refused before any RPC when it finds a problem.
Total wait shows the effective wait (Free plan 150 s wall clock => 135 s; 300 s needs a paid plan and wallClockMs 400000); per-message budget shows micro-USD as USD.
The persona table lists all personas from apps/admin/generated/content-seed.json with a tier select; personas without a mapping show the default tier.

Xem lại & phát hành shows a diff table against the active version, needs a 10-500 character note and calls publish_ai_persona_model_tiers with the draft version; only ai.manage sees it, editors see an explanation.
When the RPCs are missing the page says the migration 20261125100000 is not applied and the runtime uses code defaults; no crash.
The persona chat node in workflow-catalog.js mentions the knowledge brief layer, model tiers and streaming; admin:check passes with refreshed digests for the files changed here only.
scripts/admin-content-sync.test.mjs derives the persona count from the seed instead of 17; admin:test passes.
untouchedSurfaces: Mobile app (apps/mobile/**, App.tsx) belongs to the app agent; the App.tsx digest line in workflow-catalog.js is refreshed by the lead agent.
supabase/** (migration 20261125100000, persona-model-tiers.ts, ai-persona-chat) is read only.
packages/agent-config/persona-model-tiers.json is read only (the Admin copies the spec and a test keeps them equal).
Daily quotas stay on the existing 'Bật/tắt & hạn mức' page; this page links to it and does not change quota logic.
PLAN.md is updated by the lead agent.
No SQL applied, no function deployed, no secret read or set, .env not read.

impact.dataWrite: Through save_ai_persona_model_tiers_draft (ai.manage or ai.read+content.draft) and publish_ai_persona_model_tiers (ai.manage); both audited by the database. Nothing is written by the browser outside these RPCs; unsaved form edits stay in memory only.
impact.backendContract: Uses the three RPCs of migration 20261125100000 as written; config payload {tiers, personaTiers, platform} in the shape of packages/agent-config/persona-model-tiers.json.
impact.adminVisibility: New page with active version, draft, diff, persona map and effective wait; audit rows appear on the existing timeline.
impact.privacySafety: No user data: only model ids, numbers and persona content ids. Crisis screening and quotas never read this config.
impact.observability: Status line on the page; publish result shows the new version; database audit log ai.persona_model_tiers.draft/publish.
impact.rollback: Remove the nav item and script tag; the RPCs stay unused and the runtime keeps the code defaults. A published config is rolled back by publishing the previous config again as a new version.

canonicalContracts: packages/agent-config/persona-model-tiers.json is the single source of tier keys, output styles, bounds and platform wall clock values; apps/admin/persona-model-tiers.js keeps a copy and scripts/admin-persona-model-tiers.test.mjs checks they are equal and that the SQL spec literal matches
supabase/migrations/20261125100000_persona_model_tiers.sql nilaza_private.ai_persona_model_tiers_errors is the authoritative validator; the Admin validator mirrors its error codes
apps/admin/generated/content-seed.json is the persona list the Admin shows

managerTestPath: Admin -> AI -> Hạng model người dẫn. Before the migration: a yellow note says migration 20261125100000 is not applied and the code defaults run. After the Owner applies it: change 'Tri thức sâu' total wait to 200 s (the page shows effective 135 s on Free), set I Ching to Thường, Lưu nháp, Xem lại & phát hành, read the diff, write a note, publish; reload shows version 1 active.
